paper.title: Bounded Recursive Self-Improvement
paper.central_claim: 以autocatalysis、endogeny和reflectivity为原则，AERA从小型人工种子出发，通过环境与内部运行经验持续生成、评价、淘汰可执行模型，以价值驱动实时调度实现受设计与资源约束的递归自我改进；S1通过在线观察学会复杂人类多模态对话。原主张包含离开实验室后的持续自主性及跨任务/环境潜力，不能以受限对话的成功代替这些广义主张的验证。
paper.scope_reason: 改变对象是符号化的可执行程序及其前后条件、组合结构与内存成员，而不是神经网络参数。reliability等数值是程序控制统计量，不把其更新误当纯权重学习。固定executive并不排除上层程序的实际在线自我修改；但可编辑元控制未用于S1，不能据标题判improver。冻结锚点A3按实际被评价对象纳入。

evidence.quote:
We describe
new methodological and engineering principles for addressing these shortcomings,
that we have used to design a machine that becomes increasingly better at behaving
in underspecified circumstances, in a goal-directed way, on the job, by modeling itself
and its environment as experience accumulates.
evidence.support_explanation: 保存原始系统级改进主张及其underspecified环境范围；不是只主张复现已示范对话。

evidence.quote:
Second, to keep the system operating
within its functional boundaries, one has to ensure that some parts of the system will
never be rewritten autonomously – for example, the management of motivations shall
be excluded from rewriting as this would possibly allow the transgression of the
constraints imposed by the designers.
evidence.support_explanation: 固定动机/边界的设计理由；不是已证明的自修改安全保证。

evidence.quote:
Knowledge is composed of states (be
they past, present, predicted, desired or hypothetical) and of executable code (called
models). Models are capable of generating such knowledge (for example, generating
predictions, hypotheses or goals) and are executed by a virtual machine (in the case
of AERA, its executive).
evidence.support_explanation: 被学习/留存对象是可执行符号模型而非模型权重，支持scope及机制重建。

evidence.quote:
We also need the knowledge to be uniform, that is, encoded using one single scheme
regardless of the particular data semantics. This helps to allow execution, planning,
and learning algorithms to be both general and commensurate in resource usage
(described in more detail below).
evidence.support_explanation: 外部/内部异质知识共用单一编码方案，使执行、规划、学习使用统一算法；支持原模式主卡匹配，不宣称消除专用I/O或实证证明资源节省。

evidence.quote:
Three main cognitive processes – attention, learning and
planning – are themselves implemented by programs constituting the
adaptable part of the system, the fixed part being the executive.
evidence.support_explanation: 说明固定executive与可变程序层的权限边界；只是架构可编辑性，不足以证明改进器收益。

evidence.quote:
Models are said to be reliable
when they predict correctly and consistently so; reliable models tend to be executed
more often than unreliable models, the latter being eventually discarded when their
performance becomes unacceptable (see section 5.2 for details). In addition, a
garbage collector deletes models and composite states that have been the least
recently used.
evidence.support_explanation: 给出程序表现反馈、保留/删除与LRU规则，不把架构上的淘汰宣称当作已验证的净收益。

evidence.quote:
The first one, called forward chaining operates as follows: When an input
term matches a LT, the executive produces an output, a prediction, patterned after the
RT. In this mode, inputs can be facts holding any kind of payload, except goals. The
other mode is called backward chaining: When an input goal matches a RT, an output
is produced, a sub-goal, patterned after the LT.
evidence.support_explanation: 后续实际读取模型的双向模式匹配接口；同一可执行表示支持预测和规划。

evidence.quote:
A model is assigned a control value, its reliability, defined as the number of
times the model predicted correctly (i.e. the positive evidences of its correct operation)
divided by the total number of prediction attempts (total number of evidences) plus
one:
evidence.support_explanation: 可重建的候选信用统计；这是在线预测可靠度，不是候选净因果收益的反事实估计或统计commit保证。

evidence.quote:
It is a list of
jobs and a set of worker threads (in the sense of operating system threads) which pick
up the highest priority jobs for processing, as a result of which new jobs can possibly
be inserted in the list. Job priorities are re-computed frequently, as they depend on
time and on the current activity of the system
evidence.support_explanation: 价值/截止期驱动的执行资源分配，而非无限计算的证明搜索；调度规则可重建但不等于资源节省经过实验测量。

evidence.quote:
To avoid over-fitting, the scope of models is restricted on a case-by-case basis,
meaning that the history of relevant inputs is used to determine whether a model can
be executed or not. Relevant inputs are the inputs that have been processed by a
model (using forward chaining) and identified as having led to the success or the
failure of said model.
evidence.support_explanation: 运行历史被保存为局部适用条件，是实际失败反馈改变以后读取行为的机制；不是独立留出评测。

evidence.quote:
If the reliability of a model drops below a threshold THR1 then it is phased out: In this
mode the model can only create forward chaining jobs and produce silent predictions
that will not be eligible inputs to the regular models (i.e. models that are not phased
out). Silent predictions are still monitored, thus giving the possibility to improve to a
model that was recently getting unreliable. If the reliability of a phased out model gets
above THR1, then it is not phased out anymore and resumes its standard operation.
When the reliability of a phased out model drops below a second threshold THR2
(THR2 < THR1) then the model is deleted
evidence.support_explanation: 两阈值、静默监测、恢复和淘汰是具体机制，不是泛泛声称有记忆。全文另承认可靠度累计的切换惯性并给出固定证据数修正。

evidence.quote:
Under our assumption of insufficient knowledge, explaining in this case is much closer
to guessing than to proving, and guesses are based on the general heuristic “time
precedence indicates causality”. Models thus built by the TPXs are added to the
memory and are subjected to evaluation by prediction monitors: Their life cycle is
governed essentially by their performance.
evidence.support_explanation: TPX生成、写回、后续评估链明确，但前后时序不识别因果，作者承认猜测性；不把模型名中的causal当作实证因果识别。

evidence.quote:
All models are deleted that hold variables representing deadlines that are
unaccounted for, i.e. variables that cannot be computed neither from the LT
or RT, nor from the model’s parameters list. These models are deleted
since they would produce predictions with unbound deadlines, i.e.
predictions that cannot be monitored.
evidence.support_explanation: 可执行候选的最低可监控性门槛；不是所有输出均自动保留，不虚构提前通过留出测试的门控。

evidence.quote:
Even though self-modeling for meta-control has not been leveraged in our S1
demonstrator, this functionality has been implemented and is operational.
evidence.support_explanation: 关键负边界：元控制虽有实现声明，但S1实验并未使用；不能凭可递归架构评improver。

evidence.quote:
Our source
material was a direct recording of the real-time events in the graphical world, i.e. a
trace of the human and machine actions in the virtual world frame-by-frame; the
coding of the recordings was done by coders with years of experience in this
methodology. Parameter settings for all analysis were as follows: Minimum number of
occurrences set at 3 and significance level set at 0.0005 unless otherwise noted;
other values were set at default (see Magnusson 2006).
evidence.support_explanation: 测量确有可定位的行为录像、逐帧事件和时间模式统计，不是完全没有实验。编码一致性/盲法未报告；t-pattern显著性只涉及事件时间共现。

evidence.quote:
The speech recognition is augmented with timestamps on the words produced
(approximate accuracy of time-stamping typically +/-100 ms or better), and (in E2)
filtered through a set of 100 allowed words (necessary due to the many false positives
produced in live interaction).
evidence.support_explanation: 输入权限及外部预处理明确：不是原始音视频端到端学一切；词表过滤限定能力范围。

evidence.quote:
The seed also includes initial knowledge that models the consequences of

evidence.support_explanation: 人工种子包含动作后果知识，避免把学习前状态描述成无知识或零先验。细粒度种子清单依赖外部技术报告。

Human participants in all scenarios observed by S1 are two of the system's

A thorough inspection of the videos of S1 revealed no errors in the interaction on

evidence.quote:
We had S1 observe the humans until it accurately predicted all major event types
observed in the dialogue. We then had S1 interact with the humans for a sufficiently
long period to produce videos that could be analyzed with the t-pattern approach;

evidence.quote:
In E2 the observation period was 20 hours, which is dramatically higher than that
required in E1 for an equivalent error-free performance. This is due to the complexity
of the sentences the system had to learn in E2, which alone have dramatically greater
combinatorics than all of the behaviors observed in E1.
evidence.support_explanation: E2成本有观察时长而非完全空缺；约8000观察轮与0个后测错误为表10作者报告，不能由此推出全成本或稳健成功率。

evidence.quote:
This plot shows a non-overlapping hierarchical pattern found in all three
conditions made up from 49 events (leaf nodes) occurring in the same
order with significantly similar intervals between events. No two or more
non-overlapping patterns were found to cover more of the total combined
time, or 77% of the total combined time of all three conditions. The overall
pattern and all its sub-patterns are significant at the p < 0.005 level.
evidence.support_explanation: 具体统计结果是时间模式的覆盖与显著性，不是随机化重复学习的误差线/保留收益显著性。

evidence.quote:
When S1 was put in the
role of the interviewer, the human interviewee, on purpose, took more time than usual
answering the first questions (a situation S1 had never seen before), and this
triggered an interrupt from S1, as it predicted the overshooting of the interview’s
deadline and therefore the failure of its goals.
evidence.support_explanation: 一个具体、受限的新时序扰动示例，支持不只是逐字重放；没有重复数或干预对照，不能推广为资源/任务通用性。

evidence.quote:
To support the claim of achieving bounded self-improvement in general, one has to
demonstrate a fundamental property namely, scalability. This work is still too recent for

evidence.support_explanation: 作者自己保留general bounded self-improvement的关键未证部分；广义主张只可scoped，不视为已被关闭。

observing an improvement's effect(s) on the performance of the system in its
evidence.support_explanation: 与证明搜索谱系的明确方法差异；换页后的environment解释需连同上下文阅读，不当作测得成本或最优性证明。

However, compared to NARS
AERA is limited in other ways – for example, its abstraction capabilities are less

evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻比较包括明确劣势，不能把统一表示或在线学习当成本文独有；跨架构实验仍是未来工作。

evidence.quote:
in its current incarnation AERA is entirely dependent on observation,
as learning is exclusively triggered by unexpected goal achievement, or a prediction
that turns out to be wrong – i.e. by surprise. This limits the acquisition of knowledge to
phenomena that are directly observable – hidden causation is difficult for the current
system to figure out, as are other kinds of inexplicit relations (similarity, equivalence,
etc.).
evidence.support_explanation: 观察驱动、隐因果和探索能力的实质失败边界，不能称任意环境自主发现或已证通用因果模型。

signatures.object: 持久运行内存中的可执行LT→RT符号模型、composite states及其正/负前条件，不是神经权重
signatures.information: 固定I/O设备产生的带时间戳事实、动作efferent copy、自身模型执行轨迹和预测/目标成败；人工种子含驱动、对象/属性及动作后果知识。E2语音经100词白名单过滤；不假定观察到隐因。
signatures.operation: 预测失败或未预测的目标成功触发TPX；缓存相关历史输入，排除已解释事件，按时间建立LT/RT并抽象变量、组合状态及线性guard；不能绑定截止期的模型删除。
signatures.output: 新可执行模型与程序间前/后条件图，插入memory供后续匹配执行
signatures.conditions: 时间先后启发式依赖可观察规律；guard限制线性/可逆模板；缺知识与有限资源下只求best effort。
signatures.feedback: 自己作出的预测与随后实际感知/内部事实相符与否，以及目标意外成功；不是外部给定程序优劣标签
signatures.selection_rule: 候选先按可监控性过滤并低reliability写入，再由实际后续预测成败持续更新信用，不是独立留出集预准入
signatures.selection_data: 当前及后继在线输入流、历史监测证据；没有单独固定的commit数据集
signatures.persistence: memory保存程序直到阈值淘汰或LRU删除；实例/模型引用提供局部运行来源，但未报告持久磁盘版本、全库快照及回退历史
signatures.later_use: 新输入匹配LT触发预测；新目标匹配RT触发子目标；组合和前条件改变以后可执行路径
signatures.claimed_effect: 从小型种子学得多模态对话/指令执行能力；E1约2.5分钟观察、E2约20小时观察后后续互动作者报告无错
signatures.failure_boundary: 隐藏原因、缺乏主动好奇探索、精细种子依赖、随规模扩展尚未建立；没有候选级反事实收益测量

signatures.object: 已存程序的reliability、历史前条件、active/phased-out成员状态及LRU寿命
signatures.information: 每个模型预测的实际成败，时间区间内证据/反证，以及程序最近使用情况
signatures.operation: prediction monitor把成败回写为事实，更新可靠度并据成功/失败输入建立或泛化前条件；低于THR1只准静默预测，回升可恢复，低于THR2删除并取消依赖任务
signatures.output: 经在线筛选的可执行模型群和适用条件，抑制低可靠程序影响下游
signatures.conditions: 监控器本身可因资源取消而漏掉证据；区分真实反证与未观察到；累计经验的切换惯性需固定计数修正
signatures.feedback: 自己所作预测在之后是否兑现；并非模型单方面自我赞许
signatures.selection_rule: e+/(e+1)控制可靠度、两级阈值淘汰/恢复、近期使用驱动LRU；未提供候选净增益或非回归统计保证
signatures.selection_data: 持续在线操作流，与后继互动共用机制；不是冻结独立gate
signatures.persistence: 模型成员状态及前条件保留于memory并改变下一轮调用；删除不同于版本回滚
signatures.later_use: 调度更偏向可靠、相关模型；静默状态不能向普通程序传播预测；恢复后可重新参与正常链
signatures.claimed_effect: 在有限资源下维持可用知识、修正错误与降低故障传播
signatures.failure_boundary: 阈值数值/调参过程不完整，资源丢失与环境反证可能混合；无gate-off或store-off实验

signatures.object: 统一事实/模型表示下的调度优先级、内部执行轨迹及可调整资源阈值
signatures.information: 外部事件与内部instantiated model、截止期、目标价值、模型可靠度；固定executive暴露这些数据与控制参数
signatures.operation: 用同一模式匹配、预测/目标推理处理外部和内部事实；urgency×likelihood及模型utility给细粒度job排序，超时/低价值job可取消；元控制可利用同类输入修改阈值
signatures.output: 实时运行的认知资源分配；可建模自身执行的接口
signatures.conditions: executive及动机边界固定；知识/资源不足允许best effort而非最优/确定性保证
signatures.feedback: 内部监控事实及调度性能测量；对元控制的收益仅有实现/潜力陈述
signatures.selection_rule: 基础调度按明示方程；元控制在S1实验未启用，无可评价的改进器晋升规则
signatures.selection_data: 当前目标/预测和内外部运行流；元控制的实验选择数据not_applicable（S1未使用）
signatures.persistence: 基础模型及统计影响以后调度；S1未展示改进器代码自更新的实验留存
signatures.later_use: 同一程序库支持预测、反向子目标与组合状态；不可外推成已测得更有效的后续improver
signatures.claimed_effect: 经验与资源调度双向影响认知，设计上允许反身元控制
signatures.failure_boundary: 自编译只是未来方向，元控制未用于演示，不能视为已证improver

retained_trace.before: 人工seed包含原始动作、输入维度、驱动及部分动作后果模型，不含全部对话程序；没有报告seed-only表现曲线。
retained_trace.proposed_change: TPX由惊讶事件生成可执行模型并抽象/修订前条件。
retained_trace.selection_data_rule: 候选可监控性加在线预测可靠度，低可靠静默后恢复或删除；没有独立反事实准入测试。
retained_trace.persisted_change: 模型/前条件留在memory，未来匹配复用；不仅单次回答内自纠错。
retained_trace.later_tasks: 观察人类互动后S1替代任一角色继续与同一批人互动，包括一次未见过的故意延迟情形。
retained_trace.measured_gain: 作者报告E1/E2后测无错和人类相近的时间模式；未做留存程序移除、固定seed或固定改进器对照，故不能隔离留存改动的增益。

gap.author_gap: 手工编写的控制架构依赖预先充分指定环境/任务；无限搜索或证明驱动的自修改难在有限知识、时间和计算下实时实现。需要从小种子持续增删可执行知识，并将资源控制与认知互相耦合。
gap.checked_gap: 本文确实指定了新的非权重可变对象和可实现操作链；§7将Gödel-machine证明搜索与AERA经验筛选区分，也承认NARS同样采用AIKR且有更丰富抽象。重要残余问题是在线时序、统一反身程序和资源约束的联合工程实现，而不是首次提出经验学习或通用自主系统。邻居比较仅能核对本文叙述，缺原文无法确认其排他性断言。

claims.text: AERA从小型seed经在线经验构造可执行模型，之后能承担观察过的人类交互角色。
claims.setting: S1，无LLM基座；固定executive、Microsoft SAPI/Prosodica与动作I/O。E1对象移动的受限语言/动作；E2约100词回收访谈及更复杂手势。
claims.baseline_control: human-human行为作为目标参照；没有seed-only、冻结学习或留存库移除对照。
claims.selection_vs_test: 观察直到主要事件预测准确再转互动；后测时间上在后，但同参与者同任务约束，未给冻结独立任务集/持续学习开关。
claims.result: E1约2.5分钟、17观察轮；E2约20小时、8000观察轮；作者称后续两个角色互动均无错，t-pattern结构接近人类。
claims.denominator: 17与8000是训练观察轮数，不是后测试验分母；后测录像为若干分钟/数十分钟，完整后测句数/轮数、独立重复次数未给。
claims.budget: 观察时间与实时互动已报告；硬件与全计算/程序候选成本未报告。
claims.failure: S1行为谱较人类小；无独立后测失败分母与跨运行失败计数。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 作者原型在指定传感/动作接口和种子下，通过观察形成可复用程序并在受限后继对话中表现出能力；不证明留存改动相对冻结系统的净增益。

claims.text: 程序泛化可应对与观察不完全相同的时序情况，而非只重放示范。
claims.setting: E2采访者角色，采访长度约束；人类故意延迟初始回答。
claims.baseline_control: 没有不泛化/无预测/无留存程序的对照；仅描述一次未观察过的延迟情况。
claims.selection_vs_test: 作者称该情况未在观察中出现，但无独立生成的扰动集或重放验证。
claims.result: S1预测采访将超时并打断回答。
claims.denominator: 例子级报告，没有扰动次数与完整成功/失败统计。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 支持局部时序变化下的适应示例，不支持跨环境/任意任务的普适自主性。

claims.text: 反身表示、程序生命周期与价值调度可产生资源有界的持续递归自我改进。
claims.setting: §3–5的AERA架构与§6的S1示范；动机和executive固定，模型及部分程序可变。
claims.baseline_control: 没有固定improver、meta-control-off/on或同预算NARS/证明搜索实测对照。
claims.selection_vs_test: 在线模型信用筛选不是独立净收益检验；S1未启用self-modeling for meta-control。
claims.result: 程序生成、可靠度监控、静默恢复/删除及优先级方程详述；跨更大规模的持续改进与改进器改善未测。
claims.denominator: 两个受限任务实验；没有递归改进代际数、后代成功分母或规模曲线。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 系统提供具体可实现的非权重自构建和反馈修订流程；不能宣称已验证improver级提升、最优/安全的自修改或一般可扩展性。

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 作者报告的S1在明确的人工种子、结构化输入与受限对话约束下，通过在线观察生成并复用符号可执行模型，后续同场景实时互动表现出较高正确性和类似人类的时序结构，包括一次新延迟示例。保留程序确有设计和调用链，但未用独立、匹配干预证明其带来的净增益，最高保守判task，不宣称本席复现。
assessment.evidence_level_reason: task/retained按证据而非架构判。观察→保存模型→后继使用的链条存在，然而无seed-only/store-off及冻结独立任务，无法证明是留存改动导致更好后续表现；尤其不能把未使用的元控制当improver。
unresolved: 广义长期递归改进/可扩展性尚未被验证，作者也明确承认。
后测的完整错误分母、独立运行方差、程序库因果贡献和全成本缺失。
邻居及详细seed的独立原文未入固定包，gap比较仍有未决部分。
